quality.review_scope: All eleven supplied main pages read and visually inspected, with independent source, canonical, molecular, apparatus and reader audits. Siloxane and MPA coating routes, optional APS extension, analytical procedures, distinct color cohorts and study-wide observations retain their scope. Explicitly announced HRTEM/AFM SI not located or verified; no missing micrographs, phase, atomic coordinates or recipe–specimen links invented.
missing_fields: Declared HRTEM/AFM SI not located or inspected.
No measured atomic coordinates, refined unit cell, CIF, SAED or XRD dataset supplied.
Color labels are cohort descriptions, not universal physical-batch identifiers across tables/figures.
conflicts: Discussion C first sentence citesFigure 4 and reverses one/two peaks for silica/MPA; Figure 5, Results and following discussion establish two visible silica peaks and one MPA peak. Preserve source error.

Caption/Note 27 says heights below corresponding core/shell diameter are excluded, yet Figure 5 retains visible approximately 3–4 nm features below yellow 4.4 nm. Exact filter implementation and raw distributions are unavailable.
